Maria: Quick pass on the launch blog — need a clean claim + benchmark sanity check and an embed audit for the webinar CTA before we lock. Alex: I can own HubSpot routing + UTM mapping. ETA? Maria: Lock by EOD Wed. Need Legal signoff + ops to confirm redirects before publish. :calendar: Jess: I can take claims. Please attach the perf appendix and test conditions (seq len, batch size, batching) so I can sign off. Tom: Source = perf-report-v3. Suggested line: "up to 95% reduction in p99 latency vs baseline on our optimized runtime." I'll DM the raw numbers. Quick test summary: - Test env: rfw-prod-3 - Model: redwood-instruct-lg - Workload: mixed seq (avg 512), traffic replay - Config: batching enabled, seq <= 2048 - Result: up to 95% reduction in p99 latency vs baseline Sam: I'll do the embed audit — mobile CTA sizes, iframe fallback, snippet accessibility. Will post CSS notes. Alex: Proposed hero CTA URL + UTMs: ``` https://redwood.ai/register?utm_campaign=redwood-launch-2026&utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta ``` Mapping: HubSpot form id `5c9a`, lifecycle = lead -> mql on submit. Also adding `?ref=blog-hero` variant for A/B. Maria: Can we add a server-side fallback to `/register?plain=1` if form is down? Also hidden field `campaign=blog-launch-2026` for attribution. Alex: Yep — server retry with 30s timeout and fallback redirect. Will post redirect rules for eng-infra. Jess: Recommend final wording be "up to 95% reduction in p99 latency" to avoid absolute claims. I'll review appendix and confirm by Tue noon. Sam: Embed snippet I propose: ```
Register: Launch Webinar
``` I'll test breakpoints and send style tweak suggestions. ops-bot: Reminder — Put redirect rule requests in #eng-infra by 11:00 Wed to land in time for publish. Maria: Checklist: - Tom: attach perf appendix link (by Mon) - Alex: HubSpot mapping + final redirect rules (by Tue) - Jess: claim signoff (by Tue noon) - Sam: embed CSS + responsive notes (by Tue EOD) - Ops: confirm redirect availability (by Wed 11am) Please react with :white_check_mark: when done.
